a.name: co-outlier
a.definition: same channel, published within 45 days, both settled outliers

b.name: co-surge
b.definition: both reached the channel median in the same ISO week, same cluster-map cluster (k=40), any channel
b.caveat: crossing date is measured only for poller-read shorts; elsewhere it is the publish date

c.name: co-commenter
c.caveat: no commenter identities are stored in PAX2; comment threads are read live for display only
